provenance.provesWhat: Two separate faults in one reply. (1) The extractor refuses any text after an unfenced JSON object, so a trailing sentence blocks the run although the object parses. (2) Even without the sentence, the patch applier would refuse the patch: an unchanged file stages nothing, and applyProposedPatches (src/patch-application.ts) refuses a staged set that differs from the proposed set. The self-review drops unchanged files before applying; phases do not (docs/features/implementation-self-review/plan.md, 'Phases and remediation keep their current behaviour'). Fault (2) was replayed on 2026-10-14, at no cost: the JSON object passed to applyProposedPatches on a scratch clone at the phase 1 commit (core.autocrlf=false, scope index.html, styles.css, script.js) was refused with "staged set differs from the proposed patch: staged styles.css, proposed index.html, styles.css"; the same patch with index.html removed applied and committed (changedPaths ["styles.css"]). One sample; it says nothing about how often either happens.
